description: This file defines abstract and concrete classes for batching and delaying data fetch requests, including DataLoader, BackgroundDataLoader, and DelayedDataLoader, used for optimizing server requests in a Mattermost Redux-based application.

classes.name: DataLoader
classes.description: An abstract class for batching data fetch requests with support for custom comparators and batch size limits.

classes.name: BackgroundDataLoader
classes.description: A subclass of DataLoader that periodically fetches data in the background, suitable for low-priority updates.

classes.name: DelayedDataLoader
classes.description: A subclass of DataLoader that delays batch requests for a specified wait time, useful for components that load data asynchronously.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Adds identifiers to the pending batch, avoiding duplicates based on comparator if provided.

methods.name: prepareBatch
methods.description: Prepares a batch of identifiers up to maxBatchSize for fetching, removing them from pending identifiers.

methods.name: isBusy
methods.description: Returns true if there are pending identifiers or ongoing background/delayed fetches.

methods.name: startIntervalIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts periodic background fetching at specified interval.

methods.name: fetchBatchNow
methods.description: Immediately triggers fetching of the current batch of identifiers.

methods.name: queueAndWait
methods.description: Queues identifiers and returns a promise that resolves when data loading completes.

methods.name: startTimeoutIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts a timeout to delay batch fetching, resetting if already active.

methods.name: resolveCompletedCallbacks
methods.description: Resolves promises associated with identifiers once their data has been fetched.
